open_points.subject: A20 rule 3 and kernel start order
open_points.text: A release runs on Linux and on no other host, of any version that runs the sandbox runtime, which the start proves (A03; owner, 2026-10-18).
open_points.question: Which named module and start capability proves that the host is Linux, at what point before installation and store operations first require Linux O_NOFOLLOW, and what stated outcome occurs when that proof fails?
options: Add an explicit Linux-host check before installation.load_installation
Define sandbox.probe_sandbox success as the Linux proof and move it before all O_NOFOLLOW-dependent steps
Make Linux-only release packaging the proof and remove the claim that start proves it
open_points.default_guess: Add an explicit Linux-host check as the first start step and refuse startup on any other host.
